entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent inventory equipment icon for a mobile dark fairy-tale RPG starring Little Red Riding Hood. Visual direction: cursed storybook, restrained crimson, charcoal ink outlines, warm ivory and muted worn brass/brown. Hand-painted cartoon game icon, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render. Bold confident slightly irregular dark contour, clean simple shapes, 2-3 broad painted shade regions per material, minimal texture. Charming grim fairy-tale tone rather than horror. Must be easily readable when reduced to 96px. Only one item centered on square transparent canvas, whole object visible, 12% safe margin, object about 75% canvas, consistent upper-left light, no cast shadow outside silhouette. No labels, letters, numbers, frames, UI, backdrop, scenery, characters, effects, dense engravings or excessive tiny scratches. This is one of a coordinated five-category set. Subject: A single compact fairy-tale hunter's short sword, broad ivory steel blade with a slightly hooked tip, simple dark iron thorn-shaped crossguard, dark red wrapped grip. Blade points diagonally upper right, grip lower left. Readable weapon silhouette.
